## COLOMBIA — profile (page 144)

- Header facts: Region: Latin America & the Caribbean; income group: Upper-middle-income; lending category: IBRD; data status: Data as reported (A); population: 53.4 million; GNI: 449,478; unit line: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- Total external debt stock 2025: 255,956; change from 2024: +13.8%.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25**
  - Printed start and end values: 125,006 (2015) and 255,956 (2025).
  - Line shape: generally rising across 2015–25, with steady increases through most years; a stronger rise after the middle of the period; a brief plateau around ≈2023–24; and the peak in 2025.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations**
  - Total external debt: 255,956
    - Public & publicly guaranteed: 156,533
    - Private nonguaranteed: 79,276
    - Short-term: 20,148
  - Public & publicly guaranteed — by creditor type: 156,533
    - Multilateral: 37,446
    - Bilateral: 5,433
    - Private creditors: 113,653
  - Multilateral: 37,446
    - World Bank-IBRD: 17,119
    - IDB: 11,615
    - Other multilateral: 8,713
  - Bilateral: 5,433
    - France: 2,888
    - Germany: 2,195
    - Other bilateral: 350

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25**
  - External debt / exports: 315%; change: +10.2%; trend: fluctuating, with a marked spike around the middle of the period, then easing and rising again by 2025.
  - External debt / GNI: 57%; change: +4.9%; trend: gradual rise overall, jumping around the later middle years, then leveling off and edging up at the end.
  - Debt service / exports: 45%; change: -11.8%; trend: volatile; rose to peaks in the later middle years, fell back, rose again, and declined slightly by 2025.
  - Debt service / GNI: 8%; change: -16.1%; trend: upward overall with fluctuations; climbed through much of the period, dipped, rose again to a late peak, then fell in 2025.

- **Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025**
  - Official creditors
    - Maturity: 19 yrs
    - Grace period: 5 yrs
    - Interest rate: 4.7%
  - Private creditors
    - Maturity: 24 yrs
    - Grace period: 4 yrs
    - Interest rate: 7.6%

- Notes: Shaded band shows the 25th–75th percentile range of DRS reporting countries.
- Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
